summary: Independent recalc from quarantine/orders.csv matches all eight registered claims and both tests. R05 is the blocker: it names shipping_total and publishes no claim, but its caveat says every shipping cell was readable and the total is complete and omitted only for brevity. The same population has 2648 of 44531 rows with an unreadable shipping cell (rate 0.059464); audit_spec.yaml sets shipping_total publish never, and the check-plan excuse says the sum understates by an unknown amount. The rest of the register, answers R01-R04, populations, periods, and both registered hypotheses hold.
